author: blu
body: Proves Circle of Protection: Red. The enchantment's Oracle text compiles to PreventColorDamage Red; its controller takes no damage from red sources. A red 3/3 swinging unblocked is prevented (life stays 20); a green 3/3 connects for 3 (CoP: Red does not stop it). A red Lightning Bolt to the controller's face fizzles, while the same colour test shows a green source would land. This is the static approximation of the per-source {W} activation.
